meta.title: Toolbox
meta.description: Adds a Toolbox entry to the left sidebar of the DSH Web GUI. The panel shows a card grid; click a card to open its tool. Currently two tools ship: a JSON formatter, which pretty-prints JSON and reports the exact position of a syntax error, and an XML formatter, which indents XML and reports the exact position of a syntax error. Everything runs in this browser — no text leaves your machine — and nothing is stored between visits. Removing the plugin removes the entry and its tools.
